votes.sql:
SELECT
    substr(a.address_details, instr(a.address_details, ', ') + 2, 2) AS state,
    SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_quantity
FROM Customers c
JOIN Addresses a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY state;

SELECT 
    SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_order_quantity
FROM Customers c
JOIN Addresses a ON c.address_id = a.address_id
JOIN Customer_Orders co ON c.customer_id = co.customer_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON co.order_id = oi.order_id

votes.sql:
WITH addr_state AS (
    SELECT
        address_id,
        TRIM(SUBSTR(address_details, INSTR(address_details, ',') + 2, 2)) AS state_code
    FROM "Addresses"
)
SELECT
    a.state_code,
    SUM(CAST(oi.order_quantity AS INTEGER)) AS total_order_quantity
FROM addr_state a
JOIN "Customers" c ON c.address_id = a.address_id
JOIN "Customer_Orders" co ON co.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN "Order_Items" oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
GROUP BY a.state_code
ORDER BY a.state_code;

votes.sql:
WITH quarterly_orders AS (
    SELECT
        strftime('%Y', co.order_date)                                 AS yr,
        ((CAST(strftime('%m', co.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3) + 1 AS qtr,
        p.product_type_code,
        SUM(p.product_price * CAST(oi.order_quantity AS REAL))         AS total_order_value
    FROM Customer_Orders AS co
    JOIN Order_Items       AS oi ON co.order_id   = oi.order_id
    JOIN Products          AS p  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY yr, qtr, p.product_type_code
)
SELECT
    yr || '-Q' || qtr AS quarter,
    product_type_code,
    total_order_value
FROM quarterly_orders
ORDER BY yr, qtr, product_type_code;
